text:
She called me long-distance,

“you could never argue with me,”

she said,

“you always left.

my husband isn't like that,

he sticks to me like glue.

and he hits me.”

“I never believed in arguments,”

I said, “there's nothing to argue about.”

“you're wrong,” she said, “you should

try to communicate.”

“communicate is an overused word, like

love,” I told her.

“but don't you think two people can

love?” she asked.

“not if they try to communicate,”

I answered.

“you're talking like a fool,”

she said.

“we're arguing,”

I said.

“no,” she said, “we are trying to

communicate.”

“I have to go,” I said.

I hung up and took the phone off the hook.

I sat looking at it.

what they didn't understand was that

sometimes there is nothing to save

except the personal vindication of

one's own point of view

and that was what would cause

that blinding white flash

one of these days.

translation.title: Not Blue
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version attributed to Charles Bukowski. “Plasticola” is rendered as “glue,” preserving the simile.
